technical.summary: Mixed signals with short-term bullish structure (SMA cross, PSar, Supertrend) conflicted by weak intermediate momentum (MACD negative, price below 50-day MAs, Ichimoku below cloud) and overbought stochastic conditions; moderate confluence but elevated pullback risk.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 36 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.congressional_conviction: medium — mixed signals with one large purchase but aged transactions
sentiment.summary: Moderate buy signal driven by fear-zone contrarian opportunity and recent congressional purchase activity, though conviction is tempered by transaction recency (75+ days old) and lack of current news confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (299.36) with imminent CPI event (1 day) creates acute macro stress; normal yield curve provides limited offset; earnings in 36 days adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term technical confluence (SMA golden cross, PSar bullish, Supertrend bullish, OBV bullish) with price near support (319.74) offers defined risk entry in fear-zone contrarian opportunity.
debate.key_bear_argument: Macro crisis regime (VIX 299.36, CPI event in 1 day), price below all intermediate MAs (50/200), negative MACD, overbought stochastic (70.94), zero fundamental support, and earnings risk in 36 days create excessive downside risk that outweighs short-term technicals.

decision.entry_rationale: While price sits at support with short-term technical confluence (SMA golden cross, PSar bullish), the macro crisis regime (VIX 299.36, CPI event in 1 day) and price weakness below all intermediate MAs (50/200 SMA) create unacceptable risk-reward asymmetry for swing entry.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX crisis environment combined with imminent CPI catalyst and negative MACD momentum creates acute downside risk that negates short-term technical support; earnings in 36 days adds secondary timing risk.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case; technical confluence insufficient to overcome macro stress and fundamental weakness
decision.portfolio_note: Existing ACN position plus 1 other IT holding in 35-position portfolio argues for concentration reduction; skip entry preserves capital in crisis regime.
